fee_notes: Royalty tiered: 4.5% on $0–$700k gross revenues, 4.0% on $700k–$1.4M, 3.5% on $1.4M–$2.1M, 3.0% on $2.1M–$2.8M, 2.5% on amounts over $2.8M. Minimum annual royalties escalate from $18,000 year 1 to $58,000 year 6. Computer Software Maintenance $0–$15,600 annually depending on Office/Field Users (example: $1,300/month for 4 office + 16 field users). Transfer fee $5,000, audit fees at cost if 2%+ understatement, liquidated damages $65,000 upon termination.
